trials.outcome: Stopped by agent during second physical step. The first final pressure solve reached 1000 iterations but residual was 5.414e-7, above 1e-7. One step cost 147 s. This is a numerical-solver performance/convergence limitation, not evidence of physical instability.
trials.resume_change: Relative tolerance 0.01 for final pressure correction, maximum 200 linear iterations, maxCo=2. Physical mass conservation must be evaluated independently. Remains diagnostic, not validated.
